English: Read-only compatibility preview ({{version}}). Features not displayed: {{features}}. Saving, exporting structures, and adding this file to an editable project are disabled to protect the original file. Upgrade Facet to continue editing.

中文 / Chinese: 此文件只能兼容预览，不能覆盖；请升级后继续编辑
English: This file can only be opened as a read-only compatibility preview and cannot be overwritten. Upgrade Facet to continue editing.

中文 / Chinese: 上限需大于下限；当前仍显示 {{lo}}–{{hi}}
English: The maximum must exceed the minimum. The displayed range remains {{lo}}–{{hi}}.

中文 / Chinese: 范围未应用；当前仍显示 {{lo}}–{{hi}}
English: The range was not applied. The displayed range remains {{lo}}–{{hi}}.

中文 / Chinese: 成键结果不可用，请重新计算键。
English: Bond data is unavailable. Recalculate bonds.

中文 / Chinese: 配体选择模式与元素列表不一致。
English: The ligand selection mode does not match the element list.

中文 / Chinese: 控制面的反光强度，0% 表示无高光。效果随光照和观察角度变化。
English: Controls the intensity of specular highlights on faces. At 0%, highlights are disabled. Their appearance depends on lighting and viewing angle.

中文 / Chinese: 值越大，反光越窄、越锐利，也越依赖观察角度；高光强度为 0 时不产生效果。
English: Higher values make highlights narrower and sharper. Their appearance depends more on the viewing angle. This has no effect when highlight strength is 0.

中文 / Chinese: 密度平滑宽度必须为 0–1 Å 的有限数值
English: Density smoothing width must be a finite value from 0 to 1 Å.

中文 / Chinese: 当前密度网格的平滑工作量超出内存限制，请减小平滑宽度或关闭密度平滑
English: Smoothing this density grid would exceed the working memory limit. Reduce the smoothing width or turn off density smoothing.

中文 / Chinese: STM 密度平滑缓存不可用
English: The STM density smoothing cache is unavailable.

中文 / Chinese: 先平滑三维密度，再计算 STM；会改变计算结果。宽度 0–1 Å，0 表示关闭。
English: Smooth the 3D density before calculating STM. This changes the calculated result. Width: 0–1 Å; set to 0 to turn off smoothing.

中文 / Chinese: 平滑已算出的 STM 图像；不改原始数据导出。宽度 0.01–1 Å，0 表示关闭。
English: Smooth the calculated STM image without changing raw data exports. Width: 0.01–1 Å; set to 0 to turn off smoothing.
Set to 0 to turn off smoothing
